title: Ground-truth source lineage for money-accounting
summary: The authoritative statements this sphere restates come from Accounting Core contracts. Consult the named documents via the supplied archive before deviating from any invariant here.
procedure: For precision and persistence, open docs/PERSISTENCE_AND_PRECISION.md in accounting_core_vN.
For rounding separation, open docs/SETTLEMENT_ROUNDING_CONTRACT.md and docs/TAX_DETERMINATION_CONTRACT.md in the same archive.
For filing lifecycle and supersession, open docs/REPORTING_LIFECYCLE_CONTRACT.md and docs/REPORTING_ATTESTATION_SUBMISSION_CONTRACT.md.
For incident lineage and regression provenance read the top-level CHANGELOG.md (v0.2..v0.10) and QUALIFICATION.md.
invariants: The current observed baseline is accounting_core_v0.10.zip; re-check local versions when one arrives newer.
A sphere entry never overrides a newer Accounting Core document inside the same checkout.
Version fixes that were later reconciled (v0.3.1 sibling and v0.4.1) remain authoritative incident evidence, not current duplication.
